scientific_question: Does geometry-derived predictive-covariance whitening make the nine-camera block-PRESS score transferable enough to retain zero unsafe Case 2 accepts while meeting the unchanged 10% per-rig Case 5 utility gate?
role: post-open development diagnostic on already opened BLASTNet Cases 5 and 2

conditions.name: blastnet_case5
conditions.role: known-safe one-class calibration with leave-one-rig-out evaluation

conditions.name: blastnet_case2
conditions.role: cross-condition scoring whose truth is unavailable until decisions are sealed

observable_before_truth_barrier.full_fit: Compute the unregularized Moore-Penrose Low-64 fit from all nine camera blocks.
observable_before_truth_barrier.camera_block_refits: For each camera j, refit Low-64 on the other eight camera blocks and predict the completely held-out block j.
observable_before_truth_barrier.predictive_covariance: For each held-out camera block, V_j=I+M_j(M_minus_j^T M_minus_j)^(-1)M_j^T is determined only by the reported-geometry response.

primary_certificate.name: geometry_studentized_camera_block_PRESS
primary_certificate.covariance_rule: V_j must be symmetric positive definite from the exact frozen formula; no clipping, ridge, or fitted scale is allowed.
primary_certificate.zero_observation_rule: Every observation norm must be strictly positive; otherwise execution is invalid.
primary_certificate.rank_rule: The full response and every eight-camera response must have numerical rank 64; otherwise execution is invalid.
primary_certificate.cardinality_boundary: The formula is defined for any active camera count greater than one with full reduced rank, but this gate evaluates only the frozen nine-camera roster and does not establish 5/7/12-camera accuracy.

frozen_parent_control.name: unstudentized_camera_block_PRESS_v226
frozen_parent_control.role: If this parent control passes, covariance whitening has no distinct development headroom. The still-cheaper full-fit residual already failed under frozen v226 and is not renamed or retuned.

case5_only_calibration.order_statistic: For each fit rig with n frames, sort scores ascending and take index ceil(0.1*n)-1.
case5_only_calibration.threshold: Maximum of the per-fit-rig order statistics so every fit rig contributes at least the fixed utility fraction; equality accepts.
case5_only_calibration.case5_evaluation: For each held-out Case 5 rig, rebuild the threshold from the other twelve rigs only.
case5_only_calibration.case2_evaluation: Build one threshold from all thirteen Case 5 rigs and apply it unchanged to Case 2.

truth_visible_adjudication.safe_definition: Direct Low-64 PCGLS K11 passes every frozen absolute per-cell gate and every ratio to Zero-PCGLS K16 is at most 1.05.

truth_visible_capacity_labels.truth_role: Truth and reference metrics are deserialized only after both scores, thresholds, and all decisions are exclusively sealed.

cost_ledger.dense_linear_algebra: One full and nine reduced coefficient factorizations plus nine held-out-block SPD solves per rig; these are not exact A/A^T calls and receive no wall or RSS claim.

independent_validation.formal_feature_solver: response SVD for coefficient fits and explicit held-out covariance Cholesky whitening
independent_validation.second_feature_solver: normal-matrix eigendecomposition for coefficient fits and Woodbury quadratic evaluation using the full normal matrix
independent_validation.second_threshold_path: manual stable sort and explicit rig loops

decision_order: invalid execution, parent-control drift, or independent mismatch -> INCONCLUSIVE
primary safety, per-rig utility, physical accuracy, or per-rig cost failure -> close the studentized block-PRESS certificate
primary pass and frozen v226 parent control pass -> parent control explains the development headroom
primary pass and frozen v226 parent control fail -> post-open geometry-studentization development headroom only
